name: multi-company-portal
description: Multi-company login portal that hosts the FinTrack financial app per tenant, with master/staff accounts.
whatsNew: The sign-in screen has a small new touch: the login card now gently fades and lifts into place when the page loads. It's purely a bit of visual polish, and signing in works exactly as before.
Transaction exports (CSV/Excel/PDF) now include the member's phone number alongside their ID, so a printed or downloaded report has enough detail to follow up without going back into the app.

Tightened some behind-the-scenes safety checks: printed/exported reports handle unusual characters in a name more carefully, and a few admin-only actions (like resetting a password or deleting an account) are now double-checked before they can even be attempted.
